verdict: Bull: SNDK +6% on Rosenblatt Buy; COHR PhotonLink launched; HBM pricing intact; all three suppliers expanding simultaneously (post-2026 correction risk building).
body_md:
## Fresh developments (last 24-72 h)

**DRAM/HBM pricing (Signal 1):** TrendForce Sept 2 bulletin: Q3 server DRAM contract pricing tracking +13-18% QoQ. DDR5 16Gb spot $56.12/die, +480% YoY. HBM4 stacks ~$550/unit; TrendForce projects HBM contract prices to surge multiples higher in 2027. HBM spec negotiations stalled pending Rubin Ultra platform finalization -- upside pressure intact. Memflation firmly on.

**HBM4 ramp (Signal 2):** Samsung targeting 250K HBM wafer starts/month by end-2026 (+47% from current ~170K); SK Hynix M15X fab at ~10K/month, scaling sharply but slightly delayed (spec finalization lag). Micron doubling capacity to ~100K wafers/month by year-end (confirmed Sept 12). All three suppliers expanding simultaneously -- the structural setup for the baseline "post-2026 correction" thesis is materializing.

**Hyperscaler capex (Signal 3):** H1 2026 combined capex: $301B (+87% YoY); full-year tracking ~$815B. 2027 projections rising toward $1.3T. NVIDIA Q3 FY2027 guidance of $108B (~74% gross margin) is the sector anchor. No guide-down signals.

**AMD/Custom silicon (Signal 4):** AMD Helios racks shipping Q3 2026; confirmed adopters include OpenAI, Meta, Anthropic, Microsoft, Oracle. Amazon-Qualcomm multi-gen inference chip deal (Sept 8, up to $60B/decade) signals continued custom-silicon diversification. Google TPU 8th-gen (2nm) previewed. ASIC share-shift on track per baseline.

**Optical/photonics (Signal 5 -- VERY FRESH):** Coherent launched PhotonLink integrated optics platform Sept 21 at ECOC 2026 (Malaga) covering CPO, NPO, and chip-to-chip connectivity; revenue ramp expected Q4 CY2026. Demonstrated 3.2T OSFP pluggable, 6.4T NPO optical engine. 10+ CPO and 10+ NPO customer engagements active. Ciena investor forum (mid-Sept) guided 30% revenue CAGR 2026-2029 and drove optical sector-wide rally. LITE +~10% in sympathy.

**Solar (Signal 6):** Section 232 tariffs formalized: $0.38/W minimum import price on finished modules + 15% on polysilicon derivatives, effective December 4, 2026. Structurally beneficial for FSLR (cadmium-telluride, zero polysilicon). FSLR reaffirmed FY2026 guidance $4.9-5.2B. ENPH Texas solid-state transformer module production began (Sept 8, +5% that day). NXT (Nextpower) +154% 1-year; ARRY record $2.4B orderbook.

No notable movers: RMBS, STX, NOW, CRM, SNOW, AMPX, ALMU, GDDY, TSLA (no fundamental catalyst).

---

## Context (vs baseline)

All signals aligned with H2-2026 bull thesis. The structural watch: HBM4 capacity expanding from all three suppliers simultaneously is building the post-2026 correction risk the baseline flagged. HBM pricing still rising but supply-side setup for a 2027 correction is increasingly well-documented. Custom ASIC displacing ~1/3 merchant silicon by 2030 remains on track -- not accelerating beyond baseline.

## Most important development

**SNDK +6% on Rosenblatt Buy initiation ($2,400 PT, Sept 22)** is the most trade-actionable fresh catalyst this window. Macro anchor: NVIDIA $108B Q3 FY2027 guidance remains unchallenged. Long-horizon watch: simultaneous HBM4 capacity ramp by all three suppliers is the single most important baseline-vs-reality signal building toward the 2027 correction risk.
